what: Real-game runs of a rocket fired down the E1M1 start corridor (Chromium on Metal, Newer Game, supplied smoke): total smoke puffs after the rocket hit the far wall, at three CPU-throttled frame rates. Console output of tests/fireball_trial.js driven by the session capture script; screenshots are not retained.
reading: About 360 puffs (a ~1,090-unit flight at 3-unit spacing) at 61 fps. The few-percent shortfall at low frame rates is the missile's unobserved first frame (about 77 units at 13 fps), not emission error. Exact frame-rate independence of the emission itself is asserted in tests/smoketrail_test.js (7..1000 fps, identical positions and birth times).
caveat: A single run per setting; counts vary by a few puffs run to run because the first sighting of the missile depends on frame timing.
